membership.interval_semantics: active when in_date <= trade_date <= out_date, with null out_date treated as open-ended
membership.pre_switch_method: project SW2021 member intervals to SW2014 L1 via explicit L3 bridge
membership.historical_authority_caveat: not direct retrieval of official historical SW2014 member records

series.expected_key_rule: For every Formal date, require every industry code active under date-effective membership.

breadth.derivation_gate: sector_series and sector_membership_pit must each have PASS_SUBCOMPONENT checkpoints

verifier.behavior: Reject unresolved membership, taxonomy-switch violations, missing required industry-date keys, same-date provenance breaks, forward fill, duplicate rows, and invalid close values.

admission_gates: historical claim is always forbidden for this reconstructed package
all unresolved membership rows must be resolved with auditable backing bytes
all required Formal sector-date keys must exist exactly once
each accepted series row must prove same-date source provenance and fill_method=NONE
sector index close -> sector_adjusted_close basis must be explicitly bound
sector breadth same-day ratio numerator/denominator must be explicitly defined and approved before derivation
blockers: materialized membership parquet bytes absent from pinned public repository
materialized industry series bytes absent from pinned public repository
pre-switch projected taxonomy is not direct official SW2014 historical membership
series date gaps recorded in provenance manifest
